projectedRadiusKm.definition: sqrt(A B), distinct from volume-equivalent radius

orientation: IAU BODY713; the published prolate interpretation assumes the long axis toward Uranus and repeats B on the third axis.
qualification: Published 72 × 72 × 72 km shape approximation. The third axis repeats the minor axis by the prolate model assumption; it is not an independently measured axis. The standard grid marks unavailable mapped surface imagery, not observed terrain or albedo. Reported uncertainties belong to projected radius and axis ratio; no independent axis uncertainties are invented.
